Canadian Natural Resources Limited (2024). [Kirby South] Solvent Enhanced Steam Assisted Gravity Drainage (SE-SAGD) Pilot Project Directive 054 Annual Performance Presentation, Experimental Scheme Approval 12810 (as amended). Submitted to the Alberta Energy Regulator June 30, 2024 (confidential presentations released March 31, 2024; approval expired March 31, 2024).

Loaded: description and state-of-development of the butane SE-SAGD pilot (well_solvent-assisted). Other-values: 40-50% SOR reduction at similar oil rate, steam cut to 40-50% of SAGD rate, 80% steady-state butane recovery (G10), up to 1.5 API in situ upgrading, pilot OBIP and recovery, pump configuration. Not printed: bitumen and steam rates (slide 24 says only within pilot design), butane injected volumes, solvent-to-oil ratio, absolute SOR, energy, emissions, water; production plot (slide 7) is an image without printed labels and was not viewed; so no annual-output, flows or energy rows. Geology, seismic and compliance skipped. Locator convention: printed slide numbers (= PDF page numbers). Traps: (1) the deck is a close-out of a pilot that ran 2019-2020 (monitoring to end 2022), not a calendar-year report; (2) the first words of the title slide do not extract as text (only Assisted Gravity Drainage (SE-SAGD) Pilot Project does); title completed as Solvent Enhanced Steam from slide 4, Kirby South in brackets; (3) solvent is butane.
